name: Castle of Baron Nuvillus
title: Castle of Baron Nuvillus
summary: An Empyrean castle north-east of Shoushi ruled by the skeleton Baron Nuvillus, with the Crown of Bone, the Spinning Wheel and runed chests (acpedia). In the kit it is a compact castle on a flat meadow at z 18. A six-storey red-roofed keep with a spire (top z 49.5) rises over a green-roofed corner tower (top 33.9), a long pitched-roof great hall (top 31.9), flat-roofed stone wings and two cottages. Dead black trees and antlered 'deer web' props surround it, and lich camps lie to the east.

shots.standingOrder: Rise up the sunlit west face of the green-roofed corner tower until the red-roofed six-storey keep of Baron Nuvillus fills the sky behind it; keep 8 m off the tower wall and the dead tree to the south.
shots.notes: Rising reveal up the sunlit west face of the green-roofed corner tower. The red-roofed six-storey keep of Baron Nuvillus first peeks over the tower's spire, then stands clear against the sky as the drone tops out 21 m up. The golden-hour sun (0.74) is directly behind the lens. The edit window starts at t 4.0, while the keep's upper storeys are still clearing the corner tower's spire. LOS to them is blocked for the first 19% of the window by design, as the reveal's lead-in. The dead tree to the south stays 5.9 m away.
